Summary: Earnings Call Tone Analysis for Professional Insurance Risk Assessment
Description: As part of the underwriting risk workflow, fetch a target company's earnings call transcript via Alpha Vantage, use the Claude API to produce a structured tone (sentiment/confidence) score on management commentary, and write the quantified results back to Azure SQL for consumption by the Underwriting Intelligence UI, supporting assessment of the company's professional insurance risk exposure. All data (raw transcript, metadata, and analysis output) is persisted in Azure SQL; no ADLS is used.
Acceptance Criteria: Transcripts can be fetched by ticker + fiscal quarter, deduped, and stored in Azure SQL; Claude API returns structured JSON (overall tone score, confidence, hedging/uncertainty, forward-looking sentiment, risk flags); results written to Azure SQL with full traceability (ticker, fiscal period, run timestamp, model version); retry and logging on failure/rate-limit; UI can query the company's tone metrics via the BFF.

Parent: Earnings Call Tone Analysis for Professional Insurance Risk Assessment
Description: Integrate the Alpha Vantage EARNINGS_CALL_TRANSCRIPT endpoint. Fetch by ticker/fiscal quarter, handle pagination and speaker segmentation, and store the raw transcript text and metadata directly in Azure SQL. Includes API key management and rate-limit handling.
Acceptance Criteria: Raw transcript text and metadata persisted to Azure SQL; pagination and speaker segments handled; API key secured; rate limits and retries handled; duplicate transcripts deduped.

Parent: Earnings Call Tone Analysis for Professional Insurance Risk Assessment
Description: Design Azure SQL tables: a transcript table (transcript_id, ticker, fiscal_period, raw_text, source metadata) and an earnings_tone_analysis table (transcript_id, ticker, fiscal_period, tone scores, risk_flags JSON, model_version, created_at). Add indexes to support UI queries by ticker and fiscal period.
Acceptance Criteria: Tables created with keys and indexes; schema supports storing raw transcript and analysis output in Azure SQL only; queryable by ticker/period.

Summary: [NLP] Claude API tone scoring prompt and call layer
Parent: Earnings Call Tone Analysis for Professional Insurance Risk Assessment
Description: Design a structured prompt that forces JSON-only output and defines scoring dimensions relevant to professional insurance risk (confidence, hedging, uncertainty, forward-looking sentiment, liability/litigation cues). Implement safe parsing, JSON schema validation, and chunking + aggregation for long transcripts.
Acceptance Criteria: Prompt returns valid JSON parsed safely; schema validated; long transcripts chunked and aggregated into a single score set; scoring dimensions documented.

Parent: Earnings Call Tone Analysis for Professional Insurance Risk Assessment
Description: Build a FastAPI/batch task chaining fetch to segmentation to Claude scoring to aggregation to write-back into Azure SQL. Includes idempotency, error handling, structured logging, and model_version recording.
Acceptance Criteria: End-to-end run persists results to Azure SQL; idempotent re-runs; errors logged; model_version recorded per run.

Parent: Earnings Call Tone Analysis for Professional Insurance Risk Assessment
Description: Expose a BFF endpoint for the React frontend to retrieve tone metrics and risk flags by ticker/fiscal period from Azure SQL.
Acceptance Criteria: Endpoint returns tone metrics and risk flags by ticker/period; integrated with existing BFF auth.

Parent: Earnings Call Tone Analysis for Professional Insurance Risk Assessment
Description: Select 5-10 known companies' transcripts, manually verify the reasonableness of Claude's tone scores, calibrate the prompt and scoring rubric, and record a baseline.
Acceptance Criteria: 5-10 transcripts manually reviewed; prompt/rubric calibrated; baseline documented.
